I guess I'll start off with a question: does anybody know how exactly minion aggro works and how to efficiently trade with it. When I see pros playing they seem to be fine to lasthit, harass with spell + aa and go back to lasthitting without ever getting minion aggro.

If I try to do the same the fucking minion will chase me between lanes if it has to, which leads to very unfavorable trades most of the time, because I get all of it back in minion damage.

As far as I've noticed. Minions will target the closest thing to them first (obviously), but will immediately focus anyone who hits their champion within their range (which means, whoever does the initial damage to champion will be immediately aggro'd) Also, AA and skills will not draw minion attention; however, passing your minions and rushing theirs will cause them to aggro you.
It also looks like Minions will chase you no further than 3/4 of the way of Lux's ult. So I'd say around 1200 range?
